messages:
lee: Heads up: we're seeing intermittent 401s get retried in ruby-sdk (0.9.3) and it ends up spamming auth errors to the backend. JS/Go SDKs don't retry on 401.

priya: that's bad. do we have a minimal repro? which retry policy is enabled by default?

devon: small repro: 
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'], retry: true)
# call that triggers expired token path on the server side
client.chat.create(...)
```
Server returns 401, SDK retries 3 times with backoff, we see 3x 401 logs.

lee: exact trace snippet from logs: `Net::HTTPUnauthorized (401) -> retrying (attempt 2/3)`

priya: JS/Go treat 401 as a hard auth failure and do not retry. We should match that for parity. The only 4xx we want to retry is 429 and maybe 408/timeouts.

devon: Agreed. Implementation note: current code uses `status >= 500 || status == 429` in go, but ruby has `status >= 400 && status != 404` (oops).

lee: ok fix: change ruby retry predicate to: `return false if (400..499).include?(status) && ![429,408].include?(status)` or similar. Also add small jitter to backoff.

priya: can you open a tiny PR with unit tests? Add an integration test that stubs a 401 then ensures no retry attempts are made. Keep it small.

devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/312 
Includes: change in RetryPolicy, unit test using WebMock that asserts single request for 401, notes on parity in CHANGELOG.

docsy: remember to update the upgrade guide and sample app README, mention behavior change so users with custom middlewares are aware.

ci-bot: CI note: tests added touch network stubs — ensure WebMock is on Gemfile and tests pass on ruby 3.1/3.2 matrix. Also FYI flake detected on windows runner for these tests previously.

lee: thx. devon, add a short changelog entry `Fix: do not retry on 401 (auth) to match other SDKs` and add a quick migration note.

devon: done; added tests, updated CHANGELOG, small docs blurb. CI green except intermittent flake on 3.1-windows we can disable that runner for the unit test.

priya: can we add a tiny e2e smoke in ruby-sampleapp to exercise auth failure handling? just a mocked env var to force 401 path. helps catch regressions.

devon: added smoke job in sampleapp PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/89 — it runs a small script that asserts we don't retry on 401.

lee: LGTM, merging after CI. Thanks all. :sparkles:

ci-bot: Merged in PR #312. Release candidate bumped to v0.9.4-rc1.

docsy: I'll include a note in the SDK parity doc that 4xx semantics are aligned across SDKs (no retries except 429/408).

lee: closing loop — deployed release candidate to canary for a day, monitoring for increased 401s. will revert quickly if any regression.
